seats.Daisuke: Daisuke is cautious and struggles to express his thoughts clearly. He relies on the group's dynamics to guide his decisions and tends to follow the majority when he feels uncertain. His view shifts from hesitation to tentative participation as the discussion progresses.
seats.Midori: Midori seeks harmony and tries to mediate between conflicting viewpoints. She values emotional intelligence and tries to keep the discussion constructive. Her view remains balanced, focusing on group cohesion rather than individual suspicion.
seats.Shion: Shion is confident and analytical, often taking the lead in directing the conversation. He looks for logical flaws and challenges others to defend their positions. His view is sharp and critical, focusing on consistency and behavior.
seats.Shunichi: Shunichi is calm and sarcastic, using his composure to deflect suspicion. He tries to appear logical and reasonable while subtly steering the conversation away from himself. His view is defensive, aiming to maintain his cover.
seats.George: George is experienced and observant, preferring to listen before speaking. He makes calm judgments based on long-term patterns of behavior. His view is steady and reliable, providing a grounding presence in the discussion.
